# Badge { #anylumino.Badge }

```python
Badge(
    value='',
    description='',
    variant='neutral',
    icon='',
    icon_src='',
    icon_size='s',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Spectrum badge display control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                                        | Default     |
|-------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| value       | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.                                                                             | `''`        |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                                                                                     | `''`        |
| variant     | optional | Spectrum visual variant such as ``'accent'``, ``'primary'``, ``'negative'``, ``'positive'``, or ``'informative'``. | `'neutral'` |
| icon        | optional | Spectrum workflow icon name, for example ``'AddContent'`` or ``'HelpCircle'``.                                     | `''`        |
| icon_src    | optional | Custom icon image URL or data URI for ``sp-icon``.                                                                 | `''`        |
| icon_size   | optional | Spectrum icon size such as ``'s'``, ``'m'``, ``'l'``, ``'xl'``, or ``'xxl'``.                                      | `'s'`       |
